acc:doc.submit/c-74a45893884b5bef.claim: An ordinary document posts to the ledger when submitted.

acc:org.create/c-313abdcaa41f9df9.claim: It needs the founder's deployed, claimed account before the first write.
acc:org.create/c-313abdcaa41f9df9.observes: cli: from person-unclaimed it exits WRONG_STATE. world: no Organization, setup or Party is added.

acc:org.create/c-37a24168b5b82483.claim: The Organization's Safe is Companies House's company Safe for this founder.

acc:org.create/c-38c97cf2c6a5056c.claim: Bio and size are stored trimmed, and an over-long bio is refused.

acc:org.create/c-f18049cd600668af.claim: The same intent resumes the same Organization; a changed intent or another founder refuses.

acc:org.create/c-f76d985ce2889eda.claim: It prints and saves the exact ID before authorization, then stops at a truthful deadline.

acc:org.create/c-fae49b69ef6deed4.claim: A founder on the beta waitlist is refused until an operator admits them.
acc:org.create/c-fae49b69ef6deed4.observes: cli: from person-on-waitlist it exits FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE; after the operator admits them the same command succeeds. world: nothing is added before.

acc:org.member.grant/c-3254ec4a40c86a97.claim: The proposal mints the officer hat to the Seat's Safe, and takes one more seat first when every seat is worn.
acc:org.member.grant/c-3254ec4a40c86a97.observes: chain: the executed batch is `Hats.mintHat(hat, memberSafe)`, preceded by `changeHatMaxSupply(hat, supply + 1)` when every seat is worn

acc:org.member.grant/c-3e81e998390a6602.claim: A second change is refused while one waits.
acc:org.member.grant/c-3e81e998390a6602.observes: cli: a second grant of Invoicing to the member whose grant waits is WRONG_STATE; world: the snapshot diff shows no officer change, proposal or approval row

acc:org.member.grant/c-640d6eb596538a6f.claim: Manage people is the People hat.
acc:org.member.grant/c-640d6eb596538a6f.observes: chain: a granted `manage-people` mints the deployment's People hat; read: `org member get` shows it

acc:org.member.grant/c-6412f20281167621.claim: A grant is a Director proposal, applied once it executes.
acc:org.member.grant/c-6412f20281167621.observes: read: `org proposal get` shows the grant's proposal waiting; after the second Director approves, `org member get` shows the member wearing the hat and the change reads `applied`

acc:org.member.grant/c-6fd22fa2a0774ed8.claim: With the Director proposals gate off it is refused, and Manage books needs the books gate too.
acc:org.member.grant/c-6fd22fa2a0774ed8.observes: cli: FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `owner-safe-proposals` off, and for Manage books with `books` off; world: the snapshot diff shows no officer change, proposal or approval row

acc:org.member.grant/c-7db203df47b9ca84.claim: A Seat whose Safe already wears the hat, and a Seat with no personal Safe, are each refused before anything is proposed.
acc:org.member.grant/c-7db203df47b9ca84.observes: cli: WRONG_STATE for each; world: the snapshot diff shows no officer change, proposal or approval row

acc:org.member.grant/c-b8a4adcbed22e66d.claim: It reports one `officer_change_transitioned` (`propose`) for the proposing Director, carrying neither the Seat nor the note.
acc:org.member.grant/c-b8a4adcbed22e66d.observes: trace: exactly one officer_change_transitioned with transition propose, its actor the proposing Director and no member id, email or note in its properties

acc:org.member.grant/c-ed5a48c2e1b12719.claim: A caller who is not a Director, an email that is not a current Seat, and a grant of what the Seat holds are each refused.
acc:org.member.grant/c-ed5a48c2e1b12719.observes: cli: ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED for a member who is not a Director, INVALID_INPUT for the outsider's email, WRONG_STATE for the member already wearing the Books hat; world: the snapshot diff shows no officer change, proposal or approval row

acc:payment.send/c-37ce3ad182b6ecb0.claim: An expired approval is refused and names the wait command.
acc:payment.send/c-37ce3ad182b6ecb0.observes: cli: the refusal names `capxul payment wait` with the approval id

acc:payment.send/c-59a1c78521a27aca.claim: A signature that does not recover the account's signer, an unknown execution and another person's execution are each refused and nothing is sent.
acc:payment.send/c-59a1c78521a27aca.observes: cli: each is refused with its code; chain: no UserOperation from the Safe; read: the Payment still reads prepared

acc:payment.send/c-59edd1848ac75c56.claim: A replay of the same signature answers with the same hash and sends nothing more.
acc:payment.send/c-59edd1848ac75c56.observes: cli: the second signing answers the same UserOperation hash; chain: one UserOperationEvent, one PaymentSent

acc:payment.send/c-88977816e3ab1aa9.claim: A dated Director payment is one exact `Budgets.schedule` of the asked amount to the asked address on a v4 Budgets; another amount, recipient or contract is refused before anyone approves.
acc:payment.send/c-88977816e3ab1aa9.observes: chain: the proposal's calldata is one `Budgets.schedule` of the asked amount to the asked address on the v4 Budgets; cli: another is refused before any approval

acc:payment.send/c-c9400dfaeba081e7.claim: A signed personal payment is sent once and records its one Payment.
acc:payment.send/c-c9400dfaeba081e7.observes: chain: one UserOperation and one PaymentSent carry the payment id; read: `payment list` shows exactly one Payment for it, settled

acc:payment.send/c-dd1de9fc08186cfb.claim: A payment from a spending allowance is one `Budgets.spend` from the wearer's Safe; before anyone signs, the route must name that allowance's own active budget, and a route to another budget, a pending allowance or an unreadable list is closed unsent.
acc:payment.send/c-dd1de9fc08186cfb.observes: chain: the operation's calldata is one `Budgets.spend` on the allowance's own budget id; cli and world: another budget, a pending allowance or a failed read is refused with nothing sent

acc:payment.send/c-e0782c0ab0380104.claim: Once its Board proposal executes, each item reads `scheduled` with the scheduled id of its own `Budgets.schedule`, never one on another budget, and it still does when a chain read fails once on the way.
acc:payment.send/c-e0782c0ab0380104.observes: read: `payment get` shows each item scheduled with its id; chain: PaymentScheduled logs with the items' job nonces; world: the node's fault switch fails one read

acc:payment.send/c-f0567d73a498e614.claim: An Organization payment uses the one spending allowance you hold for the asset, and with several asks which and takes `--from`.
acc:payment.send/c-f0567d73a498e614.observes: cli: with one allowance it is used unasked; with several the CLI asks which and `--from` names one

acc:payment.send/c-fd8fc63a3750fb85.claim: A mistyped address, and a recipient that is nothing, are refused naming it.
acc:payment.send/c-fd8fc63a3750fb85.observes: cli: INVALID_RECIPIENT names the typed address or recipient; world: nothing written

acc:record.export/c-bd1acd26102d2d92.claim: An export carries the lineage and every entry once.
acc:record.export/c-bd1acd26102d2d92.observes: cli: `record export --world town3 --out run.jsonl --json` prints the line count and lineage naming town1; the file's first line is the lineage and the entries follow in order.

acc:report.run/c-6c39c42c744b8c91.claim: A report runs as the caller and the books agree with the chain.
acc:report.run/c-6c39c42c744b8c91.observes: cli: `report run "General Ledger" --filter account="Capxul Safe"` prints a ledger whose total equals the Safe's balance on chain at the world's now; a report of an off part exits FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE.

acc:world.clock.warp/c-2bceeaa41942995d.claim: A warp moves the chain and every site together and runs what fell due.
acc:world.clock.warp/c-2bceeaa41942995d.observes: cli: in `world-frozen`, `world clock warp town1 --by 7d` prints worldNow a week on; a company's site shows its scheduled job ran for each day; `--by -1d` exits INVALID_INPUT.

acc:world.create/c-43a66f24b447122c.claim: A world made from a template starts with the template's companies on their own addresses.
acc:world.create/c-43a66f24b447122c.observes: cli: `world create town2 --template town-of-four@m3 --clock frozen`; `world show town2` lists the four companies at `<company>-town2.<base>`, each answering; the born entry names no parent.

acc:world.create/c-4ee06f2f1dd89e20.claim: Production is never made without the platform owner's approval.
acc:world.create/c-4ee06f2f1dd89e20.observes: cli: `world create live --kind production --profile full --json` exits ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED and makes nothing; with the owner's one-time approval it is accepted.

acc:world.create/c-51839d5bf812fa32.claim: A `full` world gives each company a site on its own address and a `core` world gives none.
acc:world.create/c-51839d5bf812fa32.observes: cli: from `empty-devnet`, `world create core1 --profile core` then `world show core1` lists no company site; `world create full1 --profile full --template town-of-four@m3` then `world show full1` lists four sites at `<company>-full1.<base>`, each answering.

acc:world.create/c-52e22ec1e2a6c1cc.claim: A new world runs with its clock and a record that begins with its birth.
acc:world.create/c-52e22ec1e2a6c1cc.observes: cli: from `empty-devnet`, `world create town1 --template empty --clock frozen --json` prints creating; `world show town1` then prints running, clockMode frozen, epoch 1 and recordHead 1; `record list --world town1` lists one `born` entry.

acc:world.create/c-fc7bfdea5dd33f3e.claim: A fresh world can begin before host time, but an existing world's time cannot be reset.
acc:world.create/c-fc7bfdea5dd33f3e.observes: cli: `world create past1 --clock frozen --start-at 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z`; `world show past1` prints that worldNow, matching its chain head. Repeating creation with past1 exits INVALID_INPUT and leaves its clock unchanged.

acc:world.show/c-6aa449b0c9f7abaf.claim: A world restored into another names its parent.
acc:world.show/c-6aa449b0c9f7abaf.observes: cli: in `world-with-snapshot`, after `world snapshot restore town1 m3 --as town3`, `world show town3 --json` prints parentWorld town1, parentSnapshot m3 and parentSeq.

acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-1dd79fdbcb1.claim: A restore into a separate world leaves the first world untouched and the two never see each other.
acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-1dd79fdbcb1.observes: cli: `world snapshot restore town1 m3 --as town3`; both worlds list their companies on their own addresses; a command in town3 changes nothing in town1; the new born entry names town1, m3 and the sequence.

acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-369b1db183b.claim: An in-place restore returns the world to the snapshot and records it.
acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-369b1db183b.observes: cli: in `world-with-snapshot`, after more commands, `world snapshot restore town1 m3`; the diff against the saved world is empty, epoch is one higher, the record has a `restore` entry and the earlier branch is listed as abandoned.

acc:world.snapshot.save/c-69e4dbcdf13e37.claim: A snapshot saves everything that makes the world and leaves it untouched.
acc:world.snapshot.save/c-69e4dbcdf13e37.observes: cli: `world snapshot save town1 m3 --json` prints the epoch and recordSeq; the world's record gains no entry but the save; `world snapshot list town1` lists it.

alr:process_stuck/quiet.claim: a healthy world under load does not fire it

alr:rpc_failing/quiet.claim: a healthy world under load does not fire it
